description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow the increase in size of the basement to the front and with a front lightwell to No 4 of planning permission 01122/4-6/P1 approved 15/07/2014 for the Joint application for a change of use of No. 4 from 5 bedsits and 1 studio flat to a single family dwelling and erection of single storey rear and side infill extensions and formation of rear basement extension with lightwell to both No. 4 and No. 6.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (New Drawings:
A_PL_002(Rev.G), A_PL_099(Rev.H), A_PL_100(Rev.G) and A_PL_200(Rev.D) [received 21/12/2020 and A_PL_201(Rev.D), A_PL_202(Rev.D) and A_PL_203(Rev.D) [received 04/11/2020]. Approved Drawings: (PL)030 REV A, Existing side elevation, (PL)032, (PL)033, (PL)009 REV A, (PL)010 REV B, (PL)011 REV B, (PL)012 REV B, (PL)013 REV A, (PL)020 REV A, (PL)021 REV A, (PL)022, (PL)001, Flood Risk Assessment, Site Location Plan, (PL)300 REV C, (PL)302, (PL)102 REV D, (PL)103 REV D, (PL)101 REV E, (PL)200 REV B, (PL)204 REV A [received on 30/05/2014]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension and alterations hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until a Construction Method Statement (CMS) relating to the basement hereby approved has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The CMS shall be certified by a qualified professional and give details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area. The approved CMS shall be adhered to throughout the construction period for the development.

Condition : 4 - The basement extensions at 4 and 6 Thornton Avenue, W4 1QG shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment produced and provided with the previous application (Reference 1578) and the basement at either property shall not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented.
